correctness.rationale: Every partial bijection decomposes uniquely into disjoint directed chains and cycles. A word of net exponent t acts as a partial shift on a chain (rank <= max(chain vertices - |t|,0)) and as a full power on every cycle. Mutual generation implies rank equality. For a nontrivial chain this excludes |t|>=2, and t=0 is idempotent, so only t=+1/-1 remains, and rank equality forces precisely alpha or its inverse. For cycle-only supports, the generating fiber is phi(k). Labeled species give exp(sum z^j) for paths and exp(sum_{j|d} z^j/j) for cycles, Möbius inversion isolates exact order k, and the generator-fiber divisors yield E_n(a,k). The total formula and asymptotic are derived independently. A standard-library exhaustive checker directly constructs all generated sets and verifies all parameter cells n<=6. No unproved computational extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: The closest 2023 full text counts isomorphism types i(n), while the claim here is every distinct literal embedded inverse submonoid H_alpha subset I_n and its exact (largest chain, cycle order) multiplicity. Equality of generated subsets and generator-fiber size are proved separately; the 1986 representation classification does not give the embedded enumerator. Targeted published and published-finding corpus searches did not return an equivalent formula. This supports originality but not categorical exhaustiveness.

value.rationale: Counting actual distinct submonoids embedded in a fixed finite symmetric inverse monoid answers a natural and different invariant from classifying which abstract types occur. The exact two-parameter profile, uniform inverse-only generator rigidity, closed sum over cyclic subgroups, and asymptotic abundance of chain-bearing embeddings are structural and enumerative results for every n, rather than routine fixed-parameter tabulation. They provide test cases for algorithmic inverse semigroup enumeration. The claims are not presented as independent certification or as a major general theorem beyond this concrete setting.
